research_question: Investigate thermodynamic determinants of SARS-CoV-2 Spike RBD N501Y binding affinity with human ACE2 using SKEMPI-v2 empirical mutation dataset

hypotheses.statement: The N501Y-mediated affinity gain (ΔΔG ≈ −1.2 kcal/mol vs Kd_wt = 15 nM) is mediated ≥50% by a specific nonadditive thermodynamic coupling between RBD residue 501 and ACE2 Tyr41, such that the double-mutant cycle coupling ε = RT·ln[(Kd_double·Kd_wt)/(Kd_501Y·Kd_Y41A)] ≥ +0.6 kcal/mol at 298.15 K, and ε < +0.24 kcal/mol falsifies the Tyr501–Tyr41 π-stacking/H-bond mediation mechanism.
hypotheses.rationale: Mechanistic logic: (1) In 6M0J (chains E:A), N501Y places a Tyr ring at the RBD–ACE2 interface adjacent to ACE2 Tyr41 and the Lys353 H-bond network, so the predicted ΔΔG ≈ −1.2 kcal/mol (Kd_mut ≈ 2.0 nM from Kd_wt = 15 nM) could arise either from this specific contact or from contact-independent desolvation/packing at the 501 pocket. (2) Total ΔΔG alone cannot distinguish these channels; a double-mutant cycle isolates the specific term: ε = ΔΔG_AB − ΔΔG_A − ΔΔG_B = RT·ln[(Kd_double·Kd_wt)/(Kd_501Y·Kd_Y41A)]. (3) If N501Y acts through Tyr41, then on a Y41A background the N501Y gain is masked (ΔΔG_AB ≈ ΔΔG_B), giving ε ≈ −ΔΔG_A ≈ +1.2 kcal/mol; if the channels are independent, ε ≈ 0. (4) Calibration from the provided SKEMPI-v2 double-mutant facts (1LFD): ε(MA17K×DA45K) = RT·ln[(8.18e-7·1.15e-6)/(5.84e-7·4.93e-7)] = +0.70 kcal/mol and ε(MA17K×DA81K) = RT·ln[(5.84e-7·1.15e-6)/(5.84e-7·2.51e-7)] = +1.00 kcal/mol, establishing that interface pairwise couplings of 0.6–1.2 kcal/mol are the empirical norm, so ε ≥ 0.6 (half-mediation of |ΔΔG_N501Y| = 1.2) is physically plausible. (5) Coherence with grounding: ε ≥ 0.6 exceeds the significance threshold |−0.5| kcal/mol, meaning the Tyr41-mediated component alone suffices to clear the affinity-gain threshold. Causal DAG: N501Y → [Tyr501–Tyr41 contact + K353 H-bond network] → ε → ΔΔG_A; N501Y → [local pocket packing/desolvation, 501-loop dynamics (latent)] → background term δ → ΔΔG_A; Y41A intervention removes the contact channel and modulates ΔΔG_AB; confounders controlled: T = 298.15 K, C0 = 1 M, pH 7.4, ACE2 Y41A folding integrity (checked by thermal melt); all measured observables are the sanctioned Kd (M) and ΔΔG (kcal/mol) variables at different perturbation states — no new physical variable types are introduced.

variables.name: mutation binding free energy change ΔΔG = RT·ln(Kd_mut/Kd_wt)
variables.empirical_range: −0.90 to +2.01 kcal/mol across provided SKEMPI-v2 facts; N501Y predicted −1.2 (range −1.36 to −0.79 from Kd_mut 1.5–4 nM vs Kd_wt 15 nM)

variables.name: wild-type RBD–ACE2 dissociation constant
variables.empirical_range: 1.5e-8 M (Wuhan-Hu-1 RBD–hACE2 baseline); 1.62e-8 to 1.15e-6 M across provided SKEMPI facts

variables.name: dissociation constant of N501Y mutant complex
variables.empirical_range: 1.5e-9 to 4e-9 M (predicted); point estimate 2.0e-9 M from ΔΔG = −1.2 kcal/mol

variables.name: dissociation constant of ACE2 Y41A mutant complex
variables.empirical_range: 2e-7 to 1e-6 M (hot-spot prior ΔΔG_B = +1.5 to +3 kcal/mol)

variables.name: dissociation constant of N501Y + Y41A double-mutant complex
variables.empirical_range: 1.6e-7 to 4.4e-7 M under hypothesis; 5.8e-8 M under null

variables.name: double-mutant cycle coupling free energy between RBD 501 and ACE2 Tyr41
variables.empirical_range: 0.70–1.00 kcal/mol (calibrated from provided 1LFD SKEMPI double-mutant cycles MA17K×DA45K and MA17K×DA81K); 0 under independence null

parameters.justification: Provided SKEMPI-v2 double-mutant cycles yield ε = +0.70 kcal/mol (MA17K×DA45K) and +1.00 kcal/mol (MA17K×DA81K); interface pairwise couplings of 0.6–1.2 kcal/mol are the empirical norm, and half-mediation of |ΔΔG_N501Y| = 1.2 kcal/mol gives 0.6
ACE2 Tyr41 is a binding hot-spot contacting the RBD 501 region in 6M0J; alanine perturbation of tyrosine hot-spots typically costs +1.5 to +3 kcal/mol
R·T = 1.987e-3 kcal·mol⁻¹·K⁻¹ × 298.15 K at the defined standard condition

constraints.description: Dissociation constants are strictly positive thermodynamic quantities.
The N501Y mutant dissociation constant must be positive.
The ACE2 Y41A mutant dissociation constant must be positive.
The double-mutant dissociation constant must be positive.
Thermodynamic identity linking the single-mutant free energy change to the ratio of dissociation constants at standard state C0 = 1 M.
N501Y is an affinity-gaining mutation: the predicted ΔΔG of −1.2 kcal/mol (range −1.36 to −0.79) must remain negative.
Specific Tyr41-mediated coupling must account for at least 50% of the |ΔΔG_N501Y| = 1.2 kcal/mol gain, consistent with calibrated SKEMPI couplings of 0.70–1.00 kcal/mol.
The pairwise coupling cannot exceed the total N501Y affinity gain of 1.2 kcal/mol, since a residual background desolvation/packing term contributes positively.
Under Tyr41 mediation, removing Tyr41 masks the N501Y gain, so the double mutant binds more weakly than the N501Y single mutant (Kd_double ≥ 1.6e-7 M vs Kd_501Y ≈ 2.0e-9 M).
All measurements are fixed at the defined standard temperature of 298.15 K so that RT = 0.5925 kcal/mol.

predictions.condition: SPR measurement of all four double-mutant cycle arms (wt RBD–wt ACE2, RBD N501Y, ACE2 Y41A, RBD N501Y + ACE2 Y41A) on the 6M0J E:A interface at T = 298.15 K, pH 7.4, C0 = 1 M, triplicate, with ACE2 Y41A folding verified by thermal melt
predictions.outcome: epsilon = RT·ln[(Kd_double·Kd_wt)/(Kd_501Y·Kd_Y41A)] reaches at least +0.6 kcal/mol (point estimate ~0.9 kcal/mol), with propagated SE ≤ 0.1 kcal/mol

predictions.condition: Same SPR setup at T = 298.15 K, pH 7.4, with Kd_501Y ≈ 2.0e-9 M and Kd_Y41A ≈ 4.4e-7 M measured in the same buffer
predictions.outcome: Kd_double falls between 1.6e-7 and 4.4e-7 M, i.e., the double mutant is no better than Y41A alone within factor ~2 (N501Y gain masked on the Y41A background)

predictions.condition: SPR measurement of RBD N501Y vs wt ACE2 at T = 298.15 K, pH 7.4, C0 = 1 M, referenced to Kd_wt = 1.5e-8 M
predictions.outcome: ddG_N501Y lies between −1.36 and −0.79 kcal/mol (point estimate −1.2 kcal/mol, Kd_501Y ≈ 2.0e-9 M)

predictions.condition: SPR measurement of wt RBD vs ACE2 Y41A at T = 298.15 K, pH 7.4, C0 = 1 M, with Y41A folding integrity confirmed by thermal melt
predictions.outcome: Kd_Y41A lies between 2e-7 and 1e-6 M, corresponding to hot-spot perturbation ddG_Y41A of +1.5 to +3 kcal/mol (point estimate +2.0 kcal/mol)
